proposed_measurement.timing: Wall monotonic_ns + process_time_ns; exclusive/inclusive categories explicit to avoid double counting; separately record real time_ns clock anchors without patching original time.time_ns test observer
proposed_measurement.results: After original test returns/errors, before teardown, preserve records, complete error cause/context/notes/traceback, context rows and last attested diagnostics. No new dispatch/replay or synthetic terminal result.
proposed_measurement.unknown_policy: Any unknown stops that operation; record original durable running/NULL response and custody, never convert it to rejection or retry. Failure before _required_claims means that downstream boundary was not measured.
proposed_measurement.scheduling: One durable key per new diagnostic job, only after parent coordinated window; unknown start ACK reconciled with same identity; no duplicate launch.
proposed_measurement.overhead: Do not subtract instrumentation overhead or claim timing PASS from diagnostic results; any candidate optimization requires later exact-source original gates.
proposed_measurement.clock_observer_custody: Capture the real clock callable objects before running the original test. Its patch of hepta.hia_agent_service.time.time_ns changes the shared time module attribute; added diagnostic time.time_ns calls must not feed wall_reads or replace the original final observation used by observe_reference. Use the captured builtin for diagnostic anchors and never patch the original fixture observer.
proposed_measurement.no_per_file_profiling: Time current_sources/file_digests as aggregate scopes; do not attach per-file logging or whole-interpreter tracing to tens of thousands of reads. Static file count is separately bound to the exact support contract.
